## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete issue or feature and how users will experience the change.

## Validation

- [ ] Frontend lint/build pass, or explain why they do not apply.
- [ ] Relevant API/ownership/manual or automated scenarios verified.
- [ ] Schema/environment changes and migration behavior documented, if applicable.
- [ ] Feature/API/onboarding documentation and changelog updated as needed.
- [ ] Staged changes checked for credentials, local state, and generated output.

Include commands/results and identify checks that were not run.

## Review notes

Call out known limitations, compatibility changes, and follow-up work.
